creator.name: Unknown painters of the Saharan Pastoral period

object.description: Running and dancing figures in ochre on a sandstone shelter at Tanzoumaitak, on the Tassili n'Ajjer plateau in the Algerian Sahara. When they were painted the Sahara was green: the plateau's 15,000 paintings and engravings show cattle herds, giraffes, hippos and swimmers where there is now only rock and sand.
facts: Henri Lhote's expeditions in the 1950s, guided by the Tuareg Jebrine ag Mohamed, copied thousands of the paintings and made the site famous.
The Round Head period, the plateau's oldest painted style, may go back 10,000 years; the Pastoral period that follows is the richest.
Tassili n'Ajjer was listed as a World Heritage Site in 1982.
